name: Client Support
description: Adds a 'Support' item to the admin toolbar that redirects to a support destination chosen from pluggable SupportIntegration plugins; ships a core Contact Form integration as an optional submodule.
project_description:
When this module is enabled editors can ask for help from the Drupal admin UI. 

 Features 
 This module adds a Support link to the admin menu and a support form. The contents of the support form will be sent via email to a configured E-mail address (typically the developers or maintainers of the site).

 The form captures the user name and email address and the URL where the Support link was clicked.

 Users can add further textual information, links and attachments.
